**3. Positional draft-reach rates**  
No clean public “% of times teams reach X spots for position Y” table. Closest concrete numbers:  
- Early-round reaches (≥10 spots ahead of ESPN rank, non-QB, top-half R1): 89% under-performed expected career value (NYT/ESPN grades analysis).  
- Kickers/punters almost never reached early (typical range rounds 5–7; avg overall pick ~174 K / ~191 P).  
- Position hit-rate vs. slot expectation (recent drafts): TE / iOL / S / T over-perform early; ED / CB under-perform relative to pick number.
